_description: Delivery groups for the shared protocols in sync-inline-versions.md. Each canonical base tag belongs to exactly one group and carries a one-line summary and a when line, the text of a skill's guide line. node .claude/scripts/build-protocol-projection.cjs reads this file and writes .claude/skills/shared/protocols/<tag>.md plus protocols/index.json; --check fails when the projection is stale. A tag with no group, a group entry naming a tag the canonical file does not define, or a tag in two groups fails the build. universal holds exactly the four root-carried tags. inlineSkills lists the review-family skills that keep their full SYNC bodies inline: guide mode never converts them, protocol hooks deliver nothing to them, and the compliance verifier fails if one carries a guide entry. A summary must not contain a semicolon, and neither line may contain the arrow character or a line break, because the guide line is '- `tag` — summary; when → path'.
